implementation: Retain acme-fieldset with an actual owned native fieldset in its light DOM. Preserve complete author node ranges and node identity.
The legend slot uses a real native legend, retaining the first-legend disabled exception, rich content and native naming.
Native disabled updates synchronously. Children retain their own disabled properties; native/custom controls use the browser's actual form association.
Generated light-DOM rules are scoped to owned native markers and installed in the actual Document/ShadowRoot with reference-counted ownership. Existing unrelated styles are preserved.

Renderer adapters provide the stable native container before connection. Lit ranges and React 19.3 controlled children pass the prototype and actual Fieldset checks. x-acme-native-root metadata records this M22 requirement.
Use moveBefore when available; WebKit lacks it in this environment, so ordinary moves restore the displaced focus/selection.
limits: Structural child changes settle through reconciliation; this does not claim synchronous native association before a structural update settles.
Final generated React package/wrapper acceptance remains M22. The actual React prototype proves the required container ownership mechanism.
This is not actual speech-output or full-library acceptance.

fixtures.source: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/browsers';const pw=await import('/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/package/index.mjs');const results=[];for(const engine of ['chromium','firefox','webkit']){const browser=await pw[engine].launch(engine==='chromium'?{headless:true,executablePath:'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'}:{headless:true});try{const page=await browser.newPage();const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4180/components/fieldset');const form=page.locator('#fieldset-form');await form.locator('acme-button[type=submit]').click();const submission=await form.locator('output').textContent();const legend=page.locator('#fieldset-legend-example');await legend.locator('#fieldset-enable').click();const enabled=await legend.evaluate(el=>!el.disabled&&!el.querySelector('acme-switch').matches(':disabled'));await legend.locator('#fieldset-enable').click();const disabled=await legend.evaluate(el=>el.disabled&&el.querySelector('acme-switch').matches(':disabled')&&!el.querySelector('acme-checkbox').matches(':disabled'));results.push({engine,submission,enabled,disabled,errors});console.log(results.at(-1));if(engine==='chromium')await legend.screenshot({path:'/tmp/acme-m11-forms/docs-first-legend.png'});}finally{await browser.close();}}await Bun.write('/tmp/acme-m11-forms/fieldset-docs-results.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');if(results.some(r=>r.submission!=='[["alerts","yes"]]'||!r.enabled||!r.disabled||r.errors.length))process.exitCode=1;
